blocks.text: Online collaboration logon ko digital tools ke zariye kisi bhi jagah se mil kar kaam karne deta hai. Files share karte ya online baat karte waqt mehfooz platforms use karna aur safety rules par chalna zaroori hai. Talaba virtual (online) groups mein zimmedari se kaam karna seekhte hain aur zaati aur school ka data bachate hain. Mehfooz collaboration bharosa banata hai aur kaam ko fayda-mand aur izzat wala teamwork banata hai. Misal: group work ke liye Google Docs use karte waqt talaba document sirf bharosemand classmates ke saath share karein. Agar doosron ko sirf parhna hai to permission “Edit” ki jagah “View only” rakhein. Is se document ghair-zaroori tabdeeliyon se bachta hai aur kaam mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Google Docs par group project share karte waqt kitab kaun si do ehtiyatein batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Document sirf bharosemand classmates se share karein, aur jinhein sirf parhna hai un ko "Edit" ke bajaye "View only" permission dein, taake koi ghair-zaroori tabdeeli na ho.

items: Online collaboration: digital tools se kahin se bhi mil kar kaam.
Mehfooz platforms aur sahi permissions; bharosa aur achhi teamwork.
